data.name: Kawtharah
data.gender_notes: Kawtharah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kawtharah signifies an abundance of goodness, something that is ample and plentiful. It is derived from the Arabic word kathirah, which means profuse, plentiful or abundant. The name Kawtharah carries the meaning “Abundance of good” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Kawtharah usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance of good and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Named after a river in Paradise, Kawtharah symbolizes the everlasting blessings of Allah.
data.etymology: Kawtharah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundance of good.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kawtharah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: كوثره
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من كوثر، و يعني الزيادة و الكثرة في الخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم كوثره هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل كثر يكثر كثارة و كوثرا، و يعني الزيادة و الكثرة في الخير و البركة. ورد ذكر الكوثر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الكوثر، حيث قال تعالى: 'إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ'، و الكوثر هو نهر في الجنة، و أيضا يطلق على الكثير من الخيرات و البركات.

in_urdu.name: کوثرہ
in_urdu.meaning: کوثرہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت، اور اللہ کی رضا
in_urdu.long_meaning: کوثرہ ایک خوبصورت نام ہے جو اردو زبان میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت، اور اللہ کی رضا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ کوثرہ (Kawtharah) کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی بہتات اور فراوانی۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ فرماتے ہیں: 'إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ' یعنی ہم نے آپ کو کوثر (بہتات) عطا کیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कौथराह
in_hindi.meaning: कौथराह का अर्थ है सुंदर और परमेश्वर की कृपा
in_hindi.long_meaning: कौथराह एक सुंदर नाम है जो हिंदी भाषा में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इसका अर्थ है सुंदर और परमेश्वर की कृपा। यह नाम इस्लामी कैलेंडर में बहुत महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि कौथराह का अर्थ है अल्लाह की बहुतायत और प्रचुरता। यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लेखित है, जहां अल्लाह तआला कहते हैं: 'इन्ना अअतैनाकल कौत्सर' यानी हमने आपको कौत्सर (बहुतायत) दिया है।

in_pashto.name: کوټره
in_pashto.meaning: کوټره د ښکلا او د الله رضا معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: کوټره یو ښکلی نوم دی چی په پښتو ژبه کی کارول کیږي. دغه نوم د ښکلا او د الله رضا معنی لري. دا نوم په اسلامي تواریخ کی ډیر اهمیت لری، ځکه کوټره (Kawtharah) د الله تعالی د کثرت او فراوانی معنی ده. دا نوم په قرآن کریم کی ذکر شوی دی، چیرته چې الله تعالی فرمایی: 'إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ' یعني موږ تاسو ته کوثر (ډیر) در کړی دی.

in_english.name: Kawtharah
in_english.long_meaning: Kawtharah is a beautiful and significant name in Islamic culture. It is derived from the Arabic root 'kawthar', which means abundance, prosperity, and blessings. In the Quran, Surah Al-Kawthar mentions 'We have given you abundance' (108:1), signifying the blessings and mercy bestowed by Allah. The name Kawtharah symbolizes a life filled with goodness, happiness, and divine favor. It is often associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, generosity, and compassion.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic history, the name Kawtharah is associated with the Prophet Muhammad PBUH and his wife Aisha RA. The story goes that during a military campaign, the Prophet prayed for the blessing of Kawthar, which is believed to be a flowing river in paradise. The name was given to Aisha as a blessing and an indication of the abundant goodness that would come her way and her social status, as she became the mother of many children and the embodiment of excellence in motherhood.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spiritual tradition, the name Kawtharah holds deep significance as a reminder of God's endless mercy and generosity towards his believers. It represents the peace, blessings, and abundant goodness that comes from a life lived in obedience to Allah, and serves as a reminder of the gifts and blessings that come from God. Additionally, the name can be seen as a source of comfort, knowing that as believers, we have access to an abundance of goodness and blessings, both in this life and in the next. This spiritual significance is embodied in the popular Islamic dua or invocation, "Allahuma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala Aali Muhammadin, kama sallaita 'ala Ibrahima wa Ibrahima" (Oh Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as you have blessed Ibrahim and Ibrahim). It is said to be a request for Allah's blessings and goodness upon the Prophet Muhammad and his family, and is often repeated as a source of spiritual comfort and uplifting spiritual emotions, which may help some Muslims to connect with their faith and find inner peace. Explained by Seyedeh Mafijeh Mahmoodi, Islamic Studies PhD Candidate-Tehran University, Iran.
